senses.gloss:
कूण् कूण्, cl. 10. P. A. कूणयति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to draw together, contract, close.

कुण कुण, अस्, m. in composition with
अश्वत्थ and other trees or flowers; the time when
a plant bears fruit, e. g. पीलु-कुण, q. v.

कुणक कुणक, अस्, m. a young animal just
born.

कुणञ्जर कुणञ्जर, अस्, m. or कुणञ्जा, f. or
कृणञ्ज, अस्, m. a species of Chenopodium; (com-
monly Vanavetuā.)

कुणप कुणप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. क्वण्), a dead body, a corpse; a carcase; said
contemptuously of living persons; (अस्), m. a spear;
N. of a people; a stench, a foul smell; (ई), f. a small
bird, a kind of Maina or Salik [cf. विट्-सारिका];
(अस्, ई, अम्), mouldering, smelling like a dead body,
foul smelling; stinking.
—कुणप-गन्ध, अस्, m.
the smell of a dead body.

कुणरबाडव कुणर-बाडव, अस्, m., N. of a
grammarian.

कुणारु कुणारु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having a
distorted arm (?); (Sāy. fr. rt. कुण्) crying out.

कुणाल कुणाल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
क्वण्), a kind of bird; N. of a son of Aśoka; N. of
a country.

कुणि कुणि, इस्, इस्, इ, a cripple with a crooked
or withered arm, or without a hand or finger; (इस्),
m. a whitlow; the tree Cedrela Toona (तुन्न); N.
of a prince, a son of Jaya and father of Yugan-dhara;
N. of a Muni; N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra.
—कुणि-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a Muni.

कूणि कूणि, इस्, इस्, इ, crooked-armed, having
a curved or withered arm; [cf. कुणि.]

कुणिताहि कुणिताहि, इस्, m., N. of the author
of a Dharma-śāstra.

कुणिन् कुणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, only in कुणी कण-
भः, a kind of bug; [cf. उत्कुण, मत्कुण.]

कुणिन्द कुणिन्द, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
कुण्), sound, sounding.
कुण्ट् कुण्ट् = कुण्ड्, q. v.
कुण्टक कुण्टक, अस्, ई, अम्, fat, corpulent.

कुण्ठ् कुण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. कुण्ठति, -ठितुम्,
to be lame or mutilated, to be blunted or
dulled; to be lazy or stupid; cl. 10. P. कुण्ठयति,
यितुम्, to cover, conceal.

कुण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, blunt, dull; stupid; weak;
indolent, lazy, slow; foolish; [cf. अ-कुण्ठ.]
—कुण्-
ठ-ता, f. bluntness, dulness, indolence.

कुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, blunted, dulled; mutilated,
stupid; grasped, held, encircled.
—कुण्ठिताश्रि (˚त-
अश्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having its edge or corners blunted.

कुण्ड कुण्ड, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. (said to be fr.
rt. कुण्), a bowl-shaped vessel, a basin, bowl, pitcher,
jar, pot, water-pot; (अम्), n. a particular measure;
a clump, e. g. दर्भ-कुण्डम्, a clump of Darbha
grass; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a round hole in the ground,
a hole in the ground for receiving and preserving
water; a hole in general (e. g. in comp. अग्नि-कुण्ड,
a hole in the ground for receiving and preserving
consecrated fire); a pit, a vat; a pool, a well, a spring
or basin of water, especially consecrated to some holy
purpose or person; (अस्), m. a son born in adultery,
an adulterine, the son of a woman by another man
than her husband, while the husband is alive; N. of
a Nāga; a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; an epithet of Śiva;
(आ), f. an epithet of Durgā.
—कुण्ड-कीट, अस्, m.
the son of a woman of the Brāhmanical tribe born in
adultery with a man of an inferior caste; a keeper of
concubines, a man who has female slaves; a follower
of the Cārvāka doctrine or the tenets of those who
deny the authority of the Vedas.
—कुण्ड-कील, अस्,
m. a low, a vile man; see नागर.
—कुण्ड-कौ-
मुदी or कुण्ड-मण्डप-कौमुदी, f. title of a
work by Viśvanātha.
—कुण्ड-गोल, अस्, m. and
कुण्ड-गोलक, अम्, n. sour rice, gruel; see काञ्जिक.
—कुण्ड-ज, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—कुण्ड-जठर, अस्, m., N. of an old sage; [cf.
कुण्डोदर.]
—कुण्ड-धार, अस्, m., N. of a
Nāga; also of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—कुण्ड-
पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, drinking out of pitchers; कुण्ड-
पायिनाम् अयनम्, a particular religious ceremony
[cf. कौण्डपायिन].
—कुण्ड-पाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
(scil. क्रतु, &c.), a particular ceremony or sacrifice
at which ewers or pitchers are used for drinking;
(अस्), m., N. of a man (?).
—कुण्ड-प्रस्थ, अस्, m.,
N. of a town.
—कुण्ड-भेदिन्, ई, m., N. of a son
of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—कुण्ड-मण्डप-सिद्धि, इस्, f.,
N. of a work by Viṭṭhaladīkṣita.
—कुण्ड-रत्ना-
कर, अस्, m., N. of a work by Viśvanātha.
—कुण्ड-
शायिन्, ई, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—कुण्-
डाग्नि (˚ड-अग्˚), इस् or इ (?), m. or n. (?), N. of a
place; [cf. कौण्डाग्नक.]
—कुण्डाशिन् (˚ड-आश्˚),
ई, इनी, इ, one who is supported by a bastard; (ई), m.
a pander, a pimp; N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; also
of a Nāga; also of one of the attendants of Śiva.
—कुण्डोद (˚ड-उद), अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—कुण्डोदर (˚ड-उद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Nāga; a
son of Janamejaya and brother of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra;
also a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—कुण्डोद्द्योत-दर्-
शन, N. of a work by Śaṅkara-bhaṭṭa.
—कुण्डोध्नी
(˚ड-ऊध्˚), f. a cow with a full udder; a woman with
a full bosom; [cf. ऊधस्.]
—कुण्डोपधानीयक,
अस्, आ, अम् (fr. ˚ड + उपधानीय), one who uses a
pitcher as a pillow; an epithet of Pūrṇa; according
to others कुण्डोपधान is the N. of a place.
—कुण्डोपरथ, cf. कौण्डोपरथ.

कुण्डक, अम्, n. a pot; (अस्), m., N. of a son
of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; also of Kṣudraka.

कुण्डिक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra;
(आ), f. a pitcher; a student's water-pot, the Kamandalu.

कुण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with a pitcher or
water-jar; (ई), m. a horse [cf. किन्धिन् &c.]; a bastard.

कुण्डिन, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra;
N. of an author; (अम्), n. a city, the capital of the
district Vidarbha, ruled over by Bhīma, the father-
in-law of Nala, apparently the modern Kondavir in
Berar; (according to some the city is also called
Vidarbha, or m. pl. Vidarbhās, but this is rather the
name of the territory.)

कुण्डङ्ग कुण्डङ्ग, अस्, m. a bower, an ar-
bour; (a wrong reading for कुडङ्ग.)

कुण्डल कुण्डल, अम्, n. a ring, an ear-ring;
a bracelet; a fetter, a tie, a collar; the coil of a rope;
(अस्), m., N. of a Nāga; (आ), f., N. of a woman;
N. of a river; (ई), f., N. of several plants, mountain
ebony, Bauhinia Variegata [cf. काञ्चन-द्रु]; an-
other plant, Cocculus Cordifolius [cf. गुडूची]; another
plant, Mucuna Pruritus [cf. कपि-कच्छु]; N. of two
other plants, commonly called Sarpiṇī-vṛkṣa and
Kundalī-cālana.
—कुण्डल-धारण, अम्, n. the
wearing of ear-rings.
—कुण्डल-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
wearing ear-rings.
—कुण्डलाकार (˚ल-आक्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, shaped like an ear-ring or bracelet, circular,
annular.
—कुण्डलोद्द्योतितानन (˚ल-उद्द्योतित-
आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having his face radiant with glitter-
ing pendants.

कुण्डलना, f. (fr. कुण्डलय, nom. fr. कुण्डल),
encircling a word or the circle round any word which
is to be left out in a MS.

कुण्डलिका, f., N. of a metre in Prākṛt poetry;
[cf. वात-कुण्डलिका.]

कुण्डलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having ear-rings or decorated
with ear-rings; circular, annular, spiral, winding, coil-
ing; (ई), m. a snake; the spotted or painted deer; a
peacock; an epithet of Varuṇa, and of Śiva; (इनी), f.
the plant Cocculus Cordifolius [cf. गुडूची]; a parti-
cular dish, curds boiled with ghee and spices; a Śakti
or form of Durgā worshipped by the Tantrikas.

कुण्डली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, forming a ring, formed
into a circle, coiled, curled, moving in rings or circles.

कुण्डली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, formed into a ring,
coiled, curled.

कुण्डीर कुण्डीर, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, power-
ful, able; (अस्), m., N. of a man.

कुण्डृणाची कुण्डृणाची, f., Ved. a species of
animal; (Sāy.) tortuous progress.

कूणित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, shut, closed.
—कूणितेक्षण (˚त-ईक्˚), अस्, m. a hawk.

कूणकुच्छ कूणकुच्छ, अस्, m., N. of one of
Śiva's attendants.

कूणिका कूणिका, f. the horn of any animal;
the peg of a lute; [cf. कलिका.]
